text.en:
This Order shall take effect five days after its
promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
